 Cameron Diaz is back in a new Netflix movie!
 On Thursday (November 5), the streaming service debuted the first trailer for the upcoming comedy flick Bad Day starring the 54-year-old actress.
 10 
 What is Bad Day about?
 Here’s the logline: 
 An action-comedy about a single mom fighting to keep one little promise to her daughter on the absolute worst day of her life.
 Who stars in Bad Day ?
 Directed by Jake Szymanski , the Bad Day cast also includes Danielle Brooks , Rhenzy Feliz , John Higgins , Mark Duplass , Jessica Belkin , Ed O’Neill , Rob Corddry , Ayden Mayeri , Ben Schwartz , Retta , Emma Pearson , P.J. Byrne , Sherry Cola , Edi Patterson , and Beck Bennett .
 When will Bad Day be released?
 Bad Day hits Netflix on December 11.
 10 
 Bad Day marks Cameron ‘s second project with Netflix
 The new movie now marks the second project Cameron has made with Netflix since she started acting again following a 10-year break . Last year, she starred alongside longtime friend Jamie Foxx in the action/comedy flick Back in Action .
 Cameron has been very busy working on several projects in recent years and it was announced earlier this year that she will be starring in the upcoming sequel to the 1989 cult classic adventure comedy Troop Beverly Hills ! Find out more here .
